title: Vietnam Mountain Marathon — official home page (English)
claims: The English home page says '2027 race dates: to be updated' and lists six distances: 10km, 21km, 50km, 70km, 100km and 100 miles.
The page states that VMM is part of World Trail Majors, described as a non-profit alliance of 10 emblematic events.
The event has been organised since 2013, welcomes over 4,000 runners from up to 50 countries and finishes at Topas Ecolodge.
The page says the Vietnam Trail Series has raised over USD 570,000 for good causes.
The 100 miles distance is described as 161 km with 8,800 m of gain and as Vietnam's oldest miler.

verification.note: 英文主页本次读取显示 2027 dates TBD；旧域名 vietnammountainmarathon.com 同日仍显示 2026 年 9 月 17–20 日，两处并列。
